run_bash_command: run a shell command in the repository using the bash tool with SafeShell validation
register_shell_tools: register the bash shell tool definitions and handlers into an agent's tool registry
get_safe_shell: get or create a SafeShell instance with the configured agent role and repo root
get_shell_root: resolve the root path for shell operations from worktree_manager or repo_root
handle_bash: handle a bash tool call by executing the command and returning truncated output
